# Benjamin Moore

> Executive leader for growth organisations. Chief Strategy Officer at JNCTN, a growth-stage SaaS company founded in Wellington, New Zealand.

Benjamin sets company strategy, leads international expansion and capital raising, and works with investors and the Board. He does his best work in highly regulated industries, bringing strategy, risk and compliance together so growth holds up under scrutiny.

## Experience
- Chief Strategy Officer, JNCTN (2024 – present)
- Product Manager, JNCTN (2023 – 2024)
- Senior Consultant to Associate Director, PwC New Zealand (2020 – 2023)
- Solution Architect, DXC Technology (2018 – 2020)

## Expertise
Growth strategy; capital raising and investor relations; Board engagement and governance; risk and compliance; highly regulated industries; executive leadership.

## Education
- Master of Arts, Victoria University of Wellington (2018), Distinction
- Bachelor of Arts with Honours in Philosophy, Victoria University of Wellington (2016), First Class Honours
